summary: Reliance Global Group, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing adoption of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill). The Board declared a dividend of one preferred share purchase right per common share, payable September 18, 2026, with rights exercisable at $14.00 per one-thousandth of a Series A Preferred share. Rights become separable if a person or group acquires beneficial ownership of 15% or more of outstanding common stock. VStock Transfer serves as rights agent. This is a defensive measure, not a transformative special situation. Watch for potential activist or takeover developments.
